edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender is assigned the initial owner and full reflection balance in the constructor.
msg.sender becomes the from address of the public transfer.
msg.sender is used as the owner in approve.
msg.sender is used as spender and allowance owner in transferFrom.
msg.sender flows into _approve as the owner/spender argument.
msg.sender ultimately reaches _transfer as the from address.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the dev/marketing addresses.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the dev/marketing addresses.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner for setTrading.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner for blockBots.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner for unblockBot.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner for transferOwnership.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner for renounceOwnership.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependence.
The miner-influenceable timestamp is passed directly into the router swap call as deadline.
transfer invokes _transfer to perform the state-changing token movement.
transferFrom invokes _transfer for the underlying balance update.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.
balanceOf converts reflection shares through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads the current rate via _getRate.
_transfer finalizes the movement by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when the contract balance threshold is reached.
_transfer distributes contract ETH via sendETHToFee after a swap.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call to the Uniswap router, an external callback surface guarded only by lockTheSwap.
swapTokensForEth approves the router for the token amount before swapping.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to an external address, a value-transfer callback surface.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend routes the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
_tokenTransfer executes the standard reflection transfer.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when the transfer is fee-exempt.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-exempt transfer.
_transferStandard obtains amount tuples from _getValues.
_transferStandard takes team tokens via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts from sender and adds to recipient _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam adds the computed team reflection to the contract _rOwned balance.
_takeTeam reads the current rate via _getRate.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflections _rTotal.
_reflectFee increases the accumulated fee total _tFeeTotal.
_getValues derives token values through _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values through _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate via _getRate.
_getTValues multiplies the amount by the active _redisFee.
_getTValues multiplies the amount by the active _taxFee.
_getRValues scales token amounts by the rate derived from reflection state.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply compares and divides by _rTotal for the rate guard.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes _redisFee.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes _taxFee.
removeAllFee stores the previous redistribution fee.
removeAllFee stores the previous tax fee.
restoreAllFee writes back _redisFee from the backup.
restoreAllFee writes back _taxFee from the backup.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount transaction limit.
_transfer enforces the _maxWalletSize wallet limit.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
_transfer compares addresses against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide the takeFee branch.
_transfer checks the inSwap guard before swapping.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping.
_transfer gates non-owner transfers on tradingOpen.
_transfer switches _redisFee to the buy/sell configured values.
_transfer switches _taxFee to the buy/sell configured values.
Constructor mints the full reflection supply to the deployer _rOwned entry.
Constructor marks owner, contract and fee addresses as excluded from fees.
Constructor stores the Uniswap router address.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor initializes the owner to the deployer.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
blockBots writes true into the bots mapping.
unblockBot clears the bots mapping entry.
setFee writes _redisFeeOnBuy.
setFee writes _taxFeeOnBuy.
setFee writes _redisFeeOnSell.
setFee writes _taxFeeOnSell.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes _swapTokensAtAmount.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletSize writes _maxWalletSize.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes the fee-exemption mapping.
owner reads the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the new owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingAddress as the ETH recipient.
manualswap compares the caller against _developmentAddress.
manualswap compares the caller against _marketingAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient argument has no independent meaning outside the public transfer function.
The amount argument is only consumed by transfer's call to _transfer.
The sender argument is scoped to transferFrom's delegation to _transfer.
The recipient argument is scoped to transferFrom's delegation to _transfer.
The amount argument is used for the transfer and allowance reduction inside transferFrom.
The from address is only meaningful inside the core _transfer routine.
The to address is only meaningful inside the core _transfer routine.
The amount is validated and forwarded within _transfer.
The swap amount parameter belongs to the swap function that performs the external call.
The ETH amount parameter belongs to the fee-distribution function that transfers it.
The sender argument is only used by _tokenTransfer's call to _transferStandard.
The recipient argument is only used by _tokenTransfer's call to _transferStandard.
The amount argument is only used by _tokenTransfer's call to _transferStandard.
The takeFee flag only controls the removeAllFee/restoreAllFee wrapping in _tokenTransfer.
The tAmount parameter is only consumed by the reflection math in _transferStandard.
The address array parameter exists solely to be iterated by blockBots.
The fee parameter exists solely to be written to the fee state by setFee.
The local contract balance is computed and used only inside _transfer to gate the swap.
The canSwap local is computed and used only inside _transfer.
The takeFee local is a transient flag deciding fee removal around the standard transfer.
